field.label: Enable the AI audit log
field.help: Records AI service use (and, with content inspection, masked detections) in a tamper-evident hash chain. Requires the privacy notice to be acknowledged first (Privacy tab).

field.label: Retention (days)
field.help: Older records are deleted. The chain stays verifiable; the deletion is recorded.

field.label: Send to local syslog
field.help: Every record is also written to syslog (facility local5, tag l7ai-audit) as one JSON line including its hash, so it appears under System > Log Files and can be forwarded with Logging targets.

field.label: Remote syslog target
field.help: host:port (UDP, RFC 5424). An independent copy outside this firewall is what makes tampering provable: the hash chain alone cannot protect against someone who can rewrite the whole database.

field.label: Organisation notice
field.help: Optional text added to the privacy notice, for example a link to your acceptable-use policy. Plain text only.
